RUM local demo

This page loads beacon.js from the local collector. It sends at most two batched /collect beacons: a load batch at 3s (navigation + TTFB + FCP) and a tail batch at page hide (LCP + INP + CLS). Click the button (creates an interaction / finalizes LCP), then switch or close the tab to flush the tail batch.

Verify in DevTools → Network: one /rum-config.json fetch, one /web-vitals.js, and several /collect beacons (navigation + web_vitals). Then check http://localhost:8080/metrics.
